caveats: Null means not established in this transcription, never a zero default.
Merged cells in extracted_cells are unnormalized source aids; inspect original PDF.
Per-word entries for signed pairs are not permission to write isolated halves.
Gaps are not registers. No addresses inferred for DI5/6 from conflicting serial examples.
Documented defaults are source claims, not observations of a connected drive. Read active settings before motion.
pdf_pages locates the detailed table transcription; semantic_sources/default_sources identify supplementary tables. Structured definitions preserve printed conflicts and are not an access allowlist.

alarm_codes.note: Other codes remain raw; LED counts 4/5 do not establish matching register codes.

input_functions.note: 7/8 have no documented function. Do not interpret the continuous range as a function whitelist.

output_functions.note: p8 includes 9/10/11; p17 functions include 0..5 but prints range0..3. No forced-control bit for function11 is documented; this is source evidence, not an admitted enum.

software_baud.note: Selected only when SW5 is ON; activation/persistence still require their own contract.

control_bits.note: p10 explicitly requires no prior clear for position/home starts. Internal rearm and combined-bit priority are not specified; p15 describes a homing rising edge.

auxiliary_commands.note: Mutually selected command values, not combinable bits.
